note: The 18 sightings listed in SCF RFP 2 (XDR/CAP-Coverage Audit Tool and Indexer-Hardening Guide), section 6, and where Istravex stands on each. reproduced: a check fails before the fix (or at the current release, when the fix is unreleased or the issue is open) and passes after it, in CI. exercised: the corpus runs what the sighting is about and checks the current behaviour, without a before/after. not-covered: why. kit/check-results.mjs checks every claim here against the results it names.

sightings.title: --check-lcm mode for golden LedgerCloseMeta
sightings.detail: All three SDK decoders the RFP names round-trip every golden frame byte for byte, and every corpus entry agrees with the goldens. A feature, not a defect: nothing to reproduce.

sightings.title: SAC-created trustlines produce no state change (CAP-0073)
Validator dies during catchup on a bucket-entry XDR parse failure
sightings.detail: The failure is in parsing history-archive buckets during catchup, which no LedgerCloseMeta carries; the issue is open with its cause undetermined. The corpus's decoders reject malformed XDR cleanly (F-0009), but nothing here reproduces this report.

sightings.title: Limit capacity reserved when decoding VecM
About 50 data-quality issues from one audit sweep
sightings.detail: Open upstream: reproduced at the current release, v2.8.34 (amounts above 2^53 stroops lose precision).

sightings.title: Protocol 28 epic over the ETL correctness backlog
sightings.detail: The epic's XDR changes: stellar-etl v2.8.34 exports the CAP-0085 externally managed contract executable (a mainnet transaction) with no transform error and correct rows. CAP-0083's STELLAR_VALUE_EMPTY_TX_SET has not appeared on either network.

sightings.title: AddressBytea truncates muxed and signed-payload addresses
P23+ event and effect gaps from an old SDK pin (CAP-0073)
sightings.detail: Open upstream: reproduced at the current release, v2.8.34 (no trustline_created effect for SAC trust()).

sightings.title: Four indexer fixes from an ingestion-halt audit
sightings.detail: The pilot drops the muxed Soroban source on f8e5786 and indexes it on bb0b162 (#753); IX003 flags the four call sites #753 changed.

sightings.title: MuxedAddress panics on a non-address ScVal
Enforce VecM max length on serde deserialize
Ordering of asset issuers and ScVal map keys
xdr-json schemas omit types behind feature flags
scValToNative silently drops colliding map entries
Muxed account and offer IDs encode a different ID
Nine XDR validation issues in one audit pass (Writer coerces invalid inputs)
sightings.detail: Fixed on master (stellar/js-xdr#173), not yet released: reproduced on 5.0.0, the latest release, and passing on the fix built from source.

sightings.title: XDR string arms mangle non-UTF-8 bytes and lone surrogates
sightings.detail: Closed upstream by documenting that .value decodes leniently; the byte-keeping paths were always right. Every pinned release keeps a real non-UTF-8 memo's bytes; there is no before/after to show.
